title: Akoi Meexx: Catalysis
description: An in-world block manipulation datapack designed to introduce additional gameplay mechanics for Slimes and Magma Cubes.
body:
## Catalysis

Catalysis is a datapack that allows slimes and magma cubes to clean and oxidize copper blocks they land on top of, providing an in-game mechanic to increase the speed at which players can convert copper blocks to different states.

This pack was originally written for a 1.18 world and remains largely unchanged, with the exception of targeting more block types and swapping mob behaviors to have slimes be the 'cleaners' and magma cubes being the 'dirtiers' of the copper blocks.

**Features**
- Sentence above says it all.

**Future Planned Features**
- In-game advancements for nearby players when a block conversion by catalysis occurs
- Any additional copper block additions to be added.
